item.title: Daily Weather
item.description: Hello! Happy weekend! It's Sunday, October 25. Time for the weather! It's Sunday, a good day to rest and get ready for the week. Today in Shanghai, it will be drizzly. The warmest part of the day will be 23 degrees, and the coolest 18. A warm one, but nothing too fierce. There is a 73 percent chance of rain. There's a fair breeze about today too. Did you know today is day 298 of the year? There are 67 days to go until the new one. Remember to take an umbrella with you! As for tomorrow, expect it to be rather grey and cloudy, with a high of 23 degrees. Here's a question: what would you plant if you had a garden? That's your weather report. See you tomorrow!
